subject: STABLE 2/3 gate-green: non-blocking draw-time variants (runtime-spec fallback + background exact compile)
body: Host result (frame_bench cold_variants, 5 draws / 4 new variants after creation-time prewarm): encode of the cold frame 71.3 ms -> 0.50 ms (variant_us 70.8 ms -> 0.19 ms, i.e. ~14 ms -> ~0.04 ms of encode-thread stall per miss); the 5 exact variants compile in the background in ~70 ms and the next frame draws them (fallback_draws 0). Design: (1) Mali: TEGU_MALI_GENERIC_OPTION_RUNTIME_SPEC (64) in mali_graphics_compiler.c/.h: SPIR-V rewrite turns every 32-bit-int/bool specialization constant and its OpSpecConstantOps into entry-block instructions reading push words at TEGU_SPEC_PUSH_BASE(96)+4k (ascending SpecId, tegu_spec_push_scan in the header); refusals (status 2) for anything else (module-scope use, other op kinds, push block past 96, >8 constants, extra functions). fixed_frag image variant: specialized fs 768-896 B, runtime fs 1664 B, push 108 B; spirv-val clean. (2) render_pipeline.inc tegu_vf_*: per pipeline a runtime base variant per (rt, tile mode) compiled in the background at creation (prewarm); on a miss the select publishes a stand-in entry (shares the base code, carries the draw's own view bindings for the sidecar) and queues the exact compile (bounded ring 64, de-duplicated by pipeline/kind/rt/tile/key, module bytes copied, module digest re-checked at publish); the exact entry is preferred from then on; memo never caches stand-ins. render_encoder.inc writes the draw's constants (plan values, SpecId defaults otherwise) into the push words. Worker: utility-QoS dispatch_async_f drain on device, detached pthread on host; no ObjC retain on the worker (pipeline dealloc waits for its pending jobs). Variant array 32 -> 64 entries. Compiles still serialize on tegu_compiler_lock, whose tegu_lock now spins then yields/sleeps (runtime_pipeline.inc). Kill switch NORD2_METAL_VARIANT_FALLBACK=0 (A/B toggle NOT added: the 8-bit A/B word has no free bit). TEGU_PERF_VARIANT fallback_draws standins queued compiled prewarmed failed dropped stale swap_ms=avg/max per encode window. Disk cache: both compiles go through the pipeline cache as before; pack: pipeline_replay_host_test.inc waits for the background prewarm before closing (corpus 179/321 records: 34 runtime variants prewarmed, 0 refused, 308 Mali records replayed). Gates (shared tree, host Mali lib rebuilt 804987dd): run_host_tests rc0 'all offline GPU tests passed'; CA c6f PASS; render harness rc0 (32 baseline); async 6/6; integration only the known CoreAnimation pass; iOS -Werror syntax compute_frontend.m OK. Test fix: integration render_variant_threads_test.py now passes the new select out-param (PASS). Hashes: render_pipeline.inc 88c3f6e8, render_encoder.inc b984f746, mali_graphics_compiler.c 99d566b5 .h 45f39131, runtime_pipeline.inc dbe0fcfc, pipeline_replay_host_test.inc c55d2fdf, tools/frame_bench_main.m 819b0a47, frame_bench.py b92e7b0a. Device build needs: native Mali archive rebuild (RUNTIME_SPEC option) + frontend. Caveats: the first miss of a pipeline whose runtime base is not ready yet compiles blocking (as before); fallback draws run a ~2x larger shader until the exact one lands; AIR (pipeline-creation) misses are unchanged. Next: plan-memo offset keys.
